name: Rubber Woman
source:
The people dressed up in rubber suits and gas masks. They were originally completely normal humans who are nowadays called "reproduction zombies", and who are specifically made for the Closed GAME.
The females can save up to 2 liters of semen in their uterus, not to mention they have a certain gimmick attached to them.
